title: Grilled Beef Skewers with Croatian Spice
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring marinated beef skewers with a Croatian twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together nutty, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the thinly sliced beef to the marinade and mix well.
Thread the marinated beef onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with crunchy parsley and serve immediately.
